book.name: Yon
book.title: Yon Dowan Weng Olo Yone Dolanebuotabe.

content: Maliao wel aaye tang kunin ayame obonoa Yesuse skilono ibabasobe.
Fasoba singkalin amo tlamabo amo asuke asuke asuke nao mo blimaim blim sma bua Yesuse imin monea Betani bibo Lasalase kaanebua dofaanebio bib onsebe.
E inanea motemea i imeno fubaibbua einoa Matao ifanoa Yesus etem Lasalas etem eka naka mak item naniba toula bianiba imeno wembiba

Malia ole wel aaye tang ayame tom botole tem daak iba obeb tenoa Yesuse skilon dimo ibabanoa olo gabamano wafu olonoa wel game glitubanoa engubasoa e tange amo alukum bukusebe. Nakaia unangai wel aay ele walom gib mole monio sum walonabiobe.
O inasoa Yesuse okok aleyemin naka make sinanomo Yesuse debeb monea komokwali dobia ananomabib nakae, niniino Yudas Iskeliote, baanea
O wel aay ayam ele obeb monoa naka maki walonoa K300 olonoa nakaia unangai inamin namin blimi daabenamin ole fatnanota besa ye sasalanone? ge baasebe.

E weng olo baaseo inaminobe. E nakaia unangai inamin namin blimi bobolo mo funaneta baaim blimobe. E ayok henin nakabe. E funanea Ne moni kimanin naka kesoa o inanoa monio olonoa onensoa atosino ayok oisonano ge funaneta weng olo baasebe.
E inangge baasea Yesuse baanea Ibo mo owemibe! Deibueine! O ne kla gotnenoa ne kaaia tom tem wato nemfanomabibo bobolo funanota wel aay ele sin alitneno kesoa ne funania O ayam nanobo gabibe.
Niminbabe, nakaia unangai inamin namin blimi ibo amitie bekebe bliba daaye binabib otane nele ibo amito mo bekebe biamabibabo ge baabesebe.
Gode amo kimanin nakai komokwali baaniba Lasalase ananomo gesiobe.
Naka homon unang homoni wentiba Yesuse Betani bib ye biebo geiba wentib kesoa i baaniba Nibo monoba esa eka Lasalase sino kaanebua Yesuse dofaanebua bie naka esa yatemomo geniba i Betani bib onsiobe.

Yuda naka homon unang homoni Yesuse Lasalase nabaneo wengo wenteniba i komokwali wengo wentemino deibeniba i Yesuse bainobo gebaib kesoa i komokwali funaniba I inaib yole nibo Lasalase ananoba kaaneko ge omonsiobe.
Yesuse komok sumi ulab anea Yelusalem bib onsebe.
I ina biniba sibnoma bomanoa nakaia unangai Fasoba imeno dowonomo geniba teniba Yelusalem bib ye minabibi wentiba Yesuse tebebo gesiba wentensiobe.

Yesuse til dongki mene make dobonea e dim ut tounea teseo sinanggwano Gode buk temo baanoa Yelusalem bib sel ibo mo tosianimibe! Ib komok sume til dongki mene dim ut toumbia debeb tebebo genobuo e bain inanea tebea nakaia unangai flim aan inamino haa oleb moniba esu unaniba ngambianiba Islel ten nibo nib komok sume niniino dobtouleb nomo! E Sume niniin dim ota tlebo, Gode daabaneko ge ngan monsiobe.

Yesuse inaseo e okok aleyemin naka ni o mitmakamo mo tekein keim blimobe. Otane sinanoa e kaanea imin hananea ula abilim uneta ota ni Yesuse Yelusalem bib unebuo bobolo funanobta Sinanggwano Gode buk tem wengo baanobuo bain inanota watemobbiobo genobbiobe.
Sino Lasalase kaanea tom tem wat dofaibbua Yesuse nganabanea hana tam tlea nakaia unangai atemibbuei o wengo naka mak unang maki oyebiba
i Yesuse okok sumo nanebio wengo wenteniba moniba Yesus esu unaniba
e niniino dobtouleb nib kesoa Felisiei yateniba obianiba Ye temine! Nakaia unangai alukum esu uniobe. Nibo mo sbal manobta watanomabbiobabo ge omonsiobe.
Glik naka maki teniba baaniba Ni Yesuse atemom genobtabo gesiobe.
Yuda nakaia unanga isa eka Glik teni mak isa moniba Fasoba imeno wembianoba Gode niniino dobtouleb nomo geniba moniba Yelusalem bib ye bianiba

Glik naka eli moniba Yesuse okok aleyemin nakae niniino Filibe, Yelusalem bib ye bie esu unaniba baabaniba Naka sum kobo ni Yesuse atemomabbiobo ge baabasiobe. Filibe Betsaida bib sakobe. E Galili betan da tlebiotabe.
I inangge baabasiba Filibe monea Endlue baabanea dab moniba Yesuse baabaniba Aleyemin naka kobo Glik nakai teniba kobo katemomabbiobo gabiobo gesiba
Yesuse baabenea Abilim Da Tlemin Naka ne Gode ne niniino nemtouleb namabeo amo tlobe.

Ne bain baabenamabibe, kon sane molmein daaknea dabalim daak uname bala damanea yamo balinamabebe. Otane e dabalim daako mo molmein daak unim blim kene mole e mo bala damaneta yamo mo balinemebabe. Nesa makob kon sane bala damanamabe inania kaania imin hanania nakaia unangai homoni dleb mete Gode mitem danamabibe.

Nakaia unangai wanita ili bobol tem funino wafu bianiba dabalim olo inamin namino gobonimibo i amito mo biomabibbabe. Eka nakaia unangai wanita ne bobolo funaniba dabalim olo inamin namino deibonimib nakai afen smiko amit namabobe.

Nakaia unangai wanita ne okoko okok kemib mole i nene kukub nabi ota wafueine! I inaib mole ne bibo namabio naka elisa itena nomabbiobe. Nakaia unangai ne okoko okok kebibi ne Aye baanea I ayam nabinabiobo ge baanamabebo ge baabesebe.
Yesuse e kaanamabeo weng sango baabesebe.

Yesuse imin baabenea Memalo ne bobol tem daako misiam utneno otane ne Gode mo baabanita Ay kobo ne enin sumo ne dimo tam tlamabo daatneneba deitnenoko genamabibabe. Yeye ne enin olo deib tlibio kesoa ne mo inanimibabo ge baabenea

omito e Gode baabanea Ay kobo ne keb niniino kemtouleb nano ge baabasea weng mako abilim ut danoa baanoa Kobo sino ne niniino nemtouleb binebbiobe. Eka sinanomosa imin inaneba ne niniino nemtouleb namabeobo ge baasoa
nakaia unangai ye blibi weng olo wenteniba maki baaniba Am ngambebo gesiba eka maki baaniba Abisak eta baabanebo gesib blib
otane Yesuse baabenea Weng ele baano olo ne mo baatnenota ne bobol temo nemsbal maim blimobe. Weng olo ibta baabenota dosbal manobe.
Mema olo Gode dabalimo inamin namin kukubo klanea Eli kukubo misiamobe eka eli kukubo ayamobe genamabebe. E inanemeo e dabalim olo komoke Gululam esa fotebenea onanea
i ne nemeb moniba atdimo nemasaniba silo bikitneniba as baka obo bikiniba nemfaiba biania kaania nakaia unangai dleb mete ne mitem danamabibo ge baabesebe.
E weng olo baabeseo e kukubo nanea kaanamabeo weng ota baabesebe.

E inangge baabesea nakaia unanga isak baabaniba Nib hekmel wengo baanoa Gode Dofakamin Nakae mo kaanemebabo, e amit afenamabebo genobi otane kobo baaneba Abilim Da Tlemin Nakae atdimo dabasaniba silo bikibaniba as baka obo bikieiba bianea kaanamabebo gabeb yole ni mo tekein kenobbabe. Abilim Da Tlemin Naka ele wanete? gesiba

Yesuse baabenea Memalo ayal ne ibo bekebe biamabi otane ne ibo mo bekebe blita sinanomobabe. Mema yota bekebe tlania deibe unamabibe. Ne sma ibte netemna nomabbio kesoa ibo ne okoko okok kem haaine! Ibo inaib mole sinanomo mililanamino mo tlamabobabe. Mililanamino ib dimo tam tlubeno mole ibo mo teme bianibta okok kem haanomabibbabe.

Ayal ne ibo baka biania ibo ne bainobo getneine gabibe. Ibo inanimibo ayalsa nomabiobo ge baabesebe. Yudai Yesuse sma ye mo bainobo gebaim blim bisiobe. Yesuse inangge baabenea deibe monea ayok ye bisebe.
Yesuse inamin namin okok sumo nabeo Yuda nakaia unangai watemebib otane i e mo bainobo geim blim kesoa
sinanggwano Gode weng omkeimalin nakae, niniino Aisaiae, wengo baanebuo bain inasobe. Aisaiae enangge baanea

content.text: Sum kobo ni keb weng ayamo omkeimabob otane i mo bainobo gabibbabe. Eka kobo okok sumo keb titil yeb baka klabeba i watemebib otane i kobo mo bainobo gakebibbabo ge baanea dolanebiotabe.

content: Nakaia unanga eli Yesuse mo bainobo geim blim binibbuo niminbabe, Gode i bainobo galin deibo watabenebiotabe. O mitmakam osa sinanggwano Aisaiae enangge baanea

content.text: Gode i kino tum gebenea i bobol tem funino nekek gebobe nane kesoa i kino temebib otane inamin namino mo watemebibbabe. Eka i bobol temo inamin namin bobolo fumbib otane o mitmakamo mo tekein kebibbabe. I Gode bobolo funaniba esu tlib mole e klaubenea ayam anomabib otane i mo inaim blim kesoa e mo klaubeneta ayam anim blimobo ge baanea dolanebiotabe.

content: Gode Yesuse titilo ayal inamin einobuo Aisaiae alebaneta e Yesuse weng sango dolanebiobe.

Yudai komokwali maki Yesuse bainobo gabib otane i funaniba Ni bainobo galin olo omkeimasoba Gode amo Felisiei ni fotebenimiobo geniba i Felisiei tolo tosiananiba i bainobo galino ayok omwa binibbiobe.

I ina binibbuo niminbabe, i mo funanibta Gode ni niniino omfabeneko ge funaim blimobe. I funin ole Nakai ni niniino dotouleb nine genibta i bainobo galino omkeima namino deiboniba teilabbubo binibbiobe.
Nakaia unangai Yesuse wengo wentim blimi bib misiam unomabiobe.
Yesuse ngananea Nakaia unangai wanita ne bainobo geib mole olo makob i ne Aye ne nemane tlibu esa bainobo genomabiobe.
Eka nakaia unangai wanita ne natemib mole olo makob i ne Aye ne nemane tlibu esa atemomabiobe.
Gode ayal ne daakenia dabalim ele tlibio kesoa nakaia unangai wanita ne bainobo getneib mole mililambio temo mo nomabibbabe.

Nakaia unangai ne wengo wentebibbai ne mo baabenita Ibo bib misiam unomabiobo genimibabe. Niminbabe, ne dabalim olo mo tenita nakaia unangai oyebianita inamin ibo bib misiam unomabiobo, eka inamin ibo bib ayam unomabiobo galano genita tlim blimobe. Ne tenia i daabenia hengmin temo blibo dotlanang genita tlibiobe.

Ne weng olo omkeima binabio mubiang am bomanomo dimo nakaia unangai ne weng olo mo wentim blim keibbiamoei baabenia Ibo ne wengo omkayebi otane ibo mo wentim blim binibbio kesoa bib misiam unomabiobo ge baabenamabibe.
Niminbabe, ne weng olo omkeima binabio nene bobol tem funino mo omkeima binabibabe. Ne Aye ne nemane tlibue emaye omkanebeta omkeima binabibe.
Nakaia unangai wanita Ay Gode weng olo wentib mole i afen smike amit nine doboniba amit nomabib kesoa ne e weng ele omkeimabi olo ne Aye ele weng baaneme iwat omkeima binabibo ge baabesebe.
